Class RawBuildingCardData

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.factories.RawBuildingCardData
public class RawBuildingCardData extends Object
A lightweight Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to map flat JSON records of building cards.

This class acts as an intermediate data structure during the game setup phase. Since a single JSON file contains definitions for multiple distinct building subtypes (e.g., scoring, sustenance, hunt, cave painting, or instant effect buildings), many fields in this class use wrapper types (Integer, Boolean) and can be null.

The CardFactory reads instances of this class to determine the correct subtype and instantiate the concrete domain-model building entities.
